error_source: Final verbal report mixed cluster counts into candidate distribution
root_cause: PLACE_EW_PROFILE_ONLY (3) incorrectly attributed to candidates — these are cluster-only (PLACE_SPECIALIST clusters). No PLACED outcomes exist in passport candidate file (all outcomes are WIN or MISS).

VP_UNDERCOUNTING_WATCHLIST (2) incorrectly attributed to candidates — Kakirra and Man is King appear in clusters only, not in single-race passport candidates. Kakirra's VP (0.175-0.343) was below the passport candidate selection floor (VP_at_race >= 0.503).

HOLD_FOR_MORE_EVIDENCE undercounted as 7 instead of 16. The verbal report used summary fields (approve_count, vp_undercounting_count, place_ew_count etc.) not the candidate verdict_distribution field.
data_files_status: CORRECT — vfu_passport_review_candidates.jsonl, vfu_08_review_summary.json, operator_decision_queue all show correct distributions. Only the verbal final report was wrong.
code_files_status: CORRECT — scripts/ops/vfu_passport_review_queue.py was always computing correctly.
additional_finding: Passport candidate selection floor is VP >= 0.503 (only VP_HIGH_WIN and VP_CONFIRMED_FAVOURITE_WIN selected). Kakirra and Man is King (VP 0.175-0.343) could never appear in passport candidates. VFU-09 investigates this blind spot.
corrections_made: This errata document only. No code changes needed. No JSON rewriting. No history mutation.
